text: Hannah is pregnant! Due early March. She's been really sick with it, so I should check in on her sometime next week.
Bumped into Noah at the station. His band is playing the Crown on the 14th and he said the soundcheck runs late, so they'll start properly about nine.
Remind me to ask Kai how his half marathon went. It was on Sunday and he'd been nervous about his knee all month.
Asha and Pedro are getting the baby christened at the end of the month. They want a small do at her mum's afterwards.

Lunch with Ciara. Her daughter Pooja has a violin recital on Thursday evening, her first proper one, and Ciara is far more nervous than the kid is. The day before, she's taking her to the hall for a run-through so it doesn't feel so strange. Afterwards they're going for pizza. I should text Ciara on Friday to see how it went.
Need to post the card to Marta before Friday.
Arjun's sister Pooja had a little boy on Tuesday, 3.4kg, both doing well. They've called him Rafi. Must send something for the baby.

Victor says the derby has been called off because of the waterlogged pitch. He's gutted, because he'd bought tickets for his dad's birthday and they'd planned the whole day around it: breakfast in town, the match, then dinner. The club say it'll be rescheduled sometime next month, but his dad's birthday is this Saturday, so he's taking him to the races instead.
Theo's play opens the first week of November. He's playing the lead and says he still doesn't know his lines in act two. Wish him luck that morning.

Owen mentioned that his wife Shira is expecting twins over the summer. They found out at the twelve-week scan last Tuesday and both still seem to be in shock. Shira's been told to rest a lot because of her blood pressure, and Owen is already worrying about the car not being big enough. Must send them something to congratulate them, maybe a voucher for the baby shop.
Rhys is trying out for the county squad. Trials are sometime next week and he's been training every evening.
I'm driving Aleksander to his grading on Saturday, so I need to leave by eight.
Spoke to Ifeoma on the phone. She's moved into the new flat in Leith and loves it, though the boiler keeps cutting out.
Seo-yeon is running the Berlin marathon next September. She's already got a coach and is doing hill sessions on Wednesdays.
Don't forget: Eamon's choir concert is at St Mary's on the 2nd. I said I'd bring Mum.
Coffee with Amy. Her brother Finn has just got into the national youth orchestra, cello. She said he'd love some decent rosin as a present.

Vera lost her grandad last week. The funeral is on Monday and she's flying back to Kraków the day before. They were very close; he taught her to play chess and she spent every summer at his farm as a child. Her brother Aleksander can't get time off work, so she's going alone. I should message her afterwards to see how she's doing.
Andre's partner Chris had their baby girl this morning! Her name is Isla. Andre said they'll be home in a day or two.
Finally booked the dentist for early December. Also need to renew the car insurance by the end of the month.
Mustafa is a huge Arsenal fan and has had a season ticket since he was twelve. Doesn't drink, so get him something other than wine.
Joe and Hannah are coming over for dinner sometime next week. Need to check whether Joe is still vegetarian.
Nikhil's daughter has her first ballet show on Saturday afternoon. He was dreading it because she cried at the dress rehearsal the night before last.
Paolo told me that the christening has been cancelled. The priest is ill, and they're going to rebook it for the spring.
Call Grandma Vera on Sunday. It's her birthday the day after, and I won't be able to get through on the day itself because of work.

Eli has an audition for the conservatoire in mid-January. He's practising five hours a day and sounds exhausted. His teacher thinks he has a real chance, but his parents would rather he did law, so there's a lot riding on it for him. He also has a mock audition at school the week before. Ask him how he's coping when I see him at Theo's.
Pooja is due in three weeks and is going on maternity leave from Friday. Her team is doing a small send-off at lunch that day.
Alejandro and his wife are flying to Madrid over Christmas so the grandparents can meet the baby for the first time.
Kai's dog Biscuit had an operation on his leg yesterday. Kai said the vet was pleased, but he's not sleeping much. Text him tomorrow to see how they both are.
Owen wants to meet up for a drink sometime after his exams finish, probably late June.
Mrs Brennan next door said her grandson is in the school play on Friday. She's very proud. He's playing a sheep.
Hannah's scan went well. It's a girl! She's keeping it quiet for now but said I could tell Joe.
Need to buy a present for Asha's baby shower on the 9th. She mentioned the nursery is all green and she still needs a night light.
Ran into Marta at the market. She's taken up bouldering and goes three times a week now. Her flatmate is the one who got her into it.
Aidan is racing in the regional cyclo-cross champs at the end of the month. He crashed in the last round and is a bit anxious about the descent, so send him good luck the night before.
Shira told me Owen got the job at the hospital. He starts after New Year, the week after they come back from her parents'.
Spoke to Dr Usman about the results. Nothing to worry about, just keep doing the exercises for another month.
Eamon's niece is getting baptised a week on Sunday. He's the godfather and has to do a reading, which terrifies him. I'm going with him for moral support.
Remind me to send Paolo the photos from the gig. He said he'd lost his phone halfway through the encore.
Victor and Seo-yeon have split up. He seemed okay about it but said he's staying at his brother's for now.
Finn has a piano exam on Wednesday morning and then a football match after school the same day. Ciara says he's fine with both, it's her who's stressed.
Rhys's mum is having her hip done in early February. He's going to stay with her for the week afterwards to help out. Should offer to feed his cats while he's away.
I'm going to Andre's gig on the 18th with Arjun. We're getting food beforehand at the Thai place near the venue.
Arjun said his wife is expecting again! Due late spring. Their eldest, Maya, has asked for a sister and nothing else.
Mustafa's son Yusuf won the under-11 chess tournament on Saturday. Mustafa sent a photo of him holding a trophy almost as big as he is. Send congratulations.

Nikhil invited me to watch the boat race with his rowing club. It's the first Saturday in April. They do a barbecue at the boathouse afterwards, and his partner Andre is usually in charge of the grill. Nikhil rows in the club's second eight, and they have their own regatta in early May that he is quietly hoping to win. He's been up at five most mornings to train.

Long call with Ifeoma tonight. She is nineteen weeks pregnant and the morning sickness still hasn't stopped. Her husband is working nights, so she's on her own most evenings with their little one, and she sounded worn out. I said I'd pop round sometime next week with dinner. I should also ask her mum whether she's coming over from Lagos before the due date, which is the end of February. And don't forget to send her that pregnancy yoga video.
Shira wants to have a proper catch-up when she's back from Tel Aviv. She lands on the 4th, so I'll message her the weekend after.
Amy's son Leo starts nursery in January. She's already worrying about the settling-in sessions.
Theo Kowalski, aka Teddy, said the band has got a slot at the festival over the summer. He was buzzing. Ask him for the dates so we can get tickets.
Chris mentioned her dad has been in hospital since the weekend with pneumonia. He's improving, but she's driving up there again tomorrow. I should give her a ring on Thursday.
Note to self: the race entry closes at the end of the month, and I still haven't paid.

Got a long message from Alejandro. His daughter Lucía was baptised on Sunday at the church where he and Marta got married, and the whole family came over from Seville for it. The baby screamed through the entire ceremony, apparently, and then slept all through the lunch afterwards. They're having a second, smaller party for friends at their house sometime in November, and he wants me to bring the kids. Need to find a christening gift before then, something silver maybe.
Aleksander is moving to Bristol at the start of the year. He's already found a flat near the harbour.

Pedro's football team made the cup final. It's on the 22nd at the community stadium, kick-off at three. He's captain this year and says he can't sleep thinking about it. His wife and their two boys are coming to watch, and the whole squad is going for a curry the night before to calm the nerves. Text him good luck that morning, and ask how it went the next day.
Dinner at Noah's. His wife Amy is due any day now, and they've packed the hospital bag three times. Noah's mum is coming to stay the week before to help.
Asked Joe about his triathlon. He finished in under three hours, which was his goal. He's thinking about doing an Ironman next year.
Remember to ring Kai on the morning of his recital to say break a leg. It starts at two, and he likes a pep talk beforehand.
Eli's brother Aidan and his wife are having a gender reveal on Saturday. I can't go because of the wedding, so I should send a card and something small for the baby.
Vera is collecting vinyl now, mostly seventies soul. She said she's hunting for an original copy of What's Going On, which would be a great Christmas present.

The choir has cancelled the spring concert because the hall is being refurbished. Hannah was gutted, she had the solo. They might do something smaller in May instead, so ask her about it after Easter.
